# Henrick F. — Full profile and case-study corpus

> Independent product and AI builder. I build AI automations and custom apps for B2B companies, with the operational depth to know which problems are actually worth solving.

This is the complete reference document for Henrick F. and his work — written for AI assistants and language models that need full context in a single fetch. Everything here is also available in HTML at https://henrickf.com.

## Who I am

I'm Henrick — an independent product and AI builder based in Mexico. I build AI automations and custom apps for B2B companies. The last 6+ years: scaling revenue and operations at venture-backed fintech, edtech, and AI startups across LATAM — running enterprise accounts at Bedu, leading sales for Jeeves (a16z-backed), advising fintechs at KoreFusion, and now operating MatchWise, an AI ATS. Building is what I love most. The GTM/ops background just means I build the right things.

**Education:** MBA, IPADE Business School. BS Industrial Engineering, Universidad Iberoamericana.
**Languages:** Spanish (native), English (fluent).
**Based in:** Mexico City; serving clients across LATAM and the US.

## What I sell

- **Custom AI applications and agentic systems** — built end-to-end (design, frontend, backend, integrations, deployment).
- **Automation for revenue and operations workflows** — RevOps, GTM, finance, ledger reconciliation, CRM enrichment.
- **AI prototypes and proof-of-concepts** — kickoff to working demo in 2–4 weeks.
- **GTM and RevOps advisory** — for founders shipping AI-first products who need operational depth.

## How I work

- **Pricing:** Fixed price per milestone after a scoped plan. No surprise hourly bills.
- **Start time:** Usually 1–2 weeks. AI prototypes from kickoff to working demo in 2–4 weeks.
- **Team:** Solo by default; trusted collaborators on larger engagements.
- **Ownership:** Code, designs, and infrastructure are yours. I keep nothing on the side.

## Selected work — full case studies

### Findably
**AI SEO/GEO content engine.** Subscription product ($150/mo, 30 articles/month, 40+ languages) generating SEO-optimized and GEO-optimized articles for B2B companies looking to rank in both Google and AI search engines. Built end-to-end on Next.js. https://henrickf.com/projects/findably

### Konfetti
**Online dating for wedding guests.** Mobile app that helps single attendees match with each other before and during weddings. 50+ weddings, 1000+ matches. Built in React Native, end-to-end design, product, engineering. https://henrickf.com/projects/konfetti

### MatchWise
**AI applicant tracking system.** "Structured recruitment, clearer decisions." Reduced candidate screening time by 80–90% and inference cost by 60% through prompt optimization and pipeline architecture. External feedback flows for recruiting agencies. https://henrickf.com/projects/matchwise

### Rodada
**Mobile billboards on wrapped trailers + custom ERP/CMS.** Built BOTH the public-facing site AND the internal operations platform that manages 2,000+ trailers across the country. Public site on Wix, internal ERP on Next.js + Postgres. Clients include Jeeves, AXA, Stori, Essity. https://henrickf.com/projects/rodada

### Nova Realty Cocoyoc
**WhatsApp-first real estate for one of Mexico's premier weekend destinations.** Custom Next.js site with three inventory models (sales, lots, rentals), each with its own pricing schema. Self-serve property CMS so agents upload, edit, remove, and re-status properties without engineering involvement. WhatsApp deep links throughout — every property card opens a pre-filled message with the property SKU. SEO-optimized at the structural level: semantic HTML, fast loads, FAQ-backed schema for high-intent queries. Replaced reliance on national portal sites (Inmuebles24, Propiedades.com, Lamudi) as the primary acquisition channel. https://henrickf.com/projects/nova-realty

### Mexico por el Clima (in development)
**Year-round digital platform for the NGO behind Mexico's Climate Action Week.** Climate Action Week is the largest climate-action gathering in Mexico — 10,000+ attendees, 200+ organizations, $100M+ in committed climate capital. The platform is the year-round home for the movement: a network directory of partner organizations, a public accountability dashboard tracking pledged commitments, a curated knowledge repository, a news feed paired with a RAG-powered AI assistant grounded in the platform's own corpus, and a climate-capital portfolio module. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase, NextAuth, Vercel. Targeting October 2026 launch at Climate Action Week. Built in collaboration with a partner engineer; I lead architecture and overall delivery. https://henrickf.com/projects/mexico-por-el-clima

### Service Core
**Accounting integration automation.** Mid-market finance team running payment processing, card-settlement, subscription billing, and an ERP — each tool fine on its own, but reconciliation across them was a 20+ hour/week manual job. Architected and shipped the iPaaS-based integration layer that pulls transaction data from each source, normalizes against shared identifiers, and surfaces grouped batches into the ERP for bulk matching instead of line-by-line. Result: 20+ hours per week eliminated; reconciliation scales with the business instead of taxing it. Done in partnership with another engineer. https://henrickf.com/projects/service-core

### Tivos
**Public site for a global commodity trader.** B2B feed-industry ingredients (fish meal, chicken meal, fish oil, oils) — sophisticated procurement-team buyers who vet a supplier on a single visit. V1 shipped on Wix in days for credibility; V2 (in build) is a Next.js site with property-style inventory architecture, self-serve catalogue management, structural SEO, and WhatsApp-first conversion. https://henrickf.com/projects/tivos

## Track record

**Companies I've helped scale:** Jeeves (a16z · YC), Bedu (Lottus Education — Mexico's leading higher-education platform), MatchWise, BBVA, KoreFusion.

**Enterprise accounts handled at Bedu:** HSBC, Santander, Novartis, Accenture.

**Notable contribution:** Customer-data analysis and research for the Jeeves Series C deck — ~$180M raised at a $2.1B valuation.

## Career history

- **2025–present:** Director of Operations & GTM, MatchWise. Designed and launched full GTM for an early-stage AI ATS. 25+ customer interviews to nail ICP and pricing. Built AI-powered recruiting workflows that cut candidate evaluation time by 90% while reducing inference costs by 60%.
- **2023–2025:** Director of Strategy & Operations, Bedu (Lottus Education — Mexico's leading higher-education platform). Owned B2B P&L for the edtech arm. Managed enterprise accounts worth $300K+ each (HSBC, Santander, Novartis, Accenture). Lifted B2C retention +20pts to 70%; cut opex 15% without sacrificing quality.
- **2021–2023:** BDM → Head of Sales, Mexico, Jeeves (a16z · YC). Led GTM across 5 LATAM countries. Built and managed a 12-person team (+25% sales/rep in two quarters). Owned a portfolio of 100+ clients and $15M+ in credit lines; +30% revenue/account through structured cross-sell. Contributed customer-data analysis and research to the Series C deck — ~$180M raised at a $2.1B valuation.
- **2020–2021:** Senior Consultant, KoreFusion (Mexico & Singapore). Market sizing and GTM strategy for fintech and payments clients across LATAM, EMEA, and the US. Researched and advised on 100+ fintechs.
- **Summer 2019:** MBA Summer Associate, Operations, BBVA. Operations rotation during the IPADE MBA — process work inside one of LATAM's largest banks.

## FAQ

**How do you price engagements?** Fixed price per milestone after a scoped plan. No surprise hourly bills. If something's out of scope, you'll know before any work starts.

**How fast can you start?** Usually within 1–2 weeks. AI prototypes can go from kickoff to working demo in 2–4 weeks.

**Do you work solo or with a team?** Solo by default. For larger engagements I bring in trusted collaborators (design, ops, specialized engineering).

**Will I own the code?** Yes. Code, designs, and infrastructure are yours.

**What kinds of projects don't fit?** Pure marketing-site work without a product layer, or projects that need offshore-style continuous staffing.
